title: Grok Imagine Prompt Planner Input Schema
description: Input specification for generating optimized prompt packages for Grok Imagine-style media workflows. Covers text-to-image, image editing, text-to-video, image-to-video, and existing video editing. Separates API-supported controls from cinematic prompt hints so a downstream media-generation skill can execute through the app gateway.

mode.title: 1. Prompt Planning Mode
mode.description: Target media workflow for prompt planning. `video-edit` plans edits for an existing MP4 via video_url. `image-to-image` and `image-to-video` accept URLs or data URIs in reference_images.

enumDescriptions.text-to-image: Plan prompt(s) for image generation from text
enumDescriptions.image-to-image: Plan prompt(s) for editing or restyling image(s) using 1-3 source images
enumDescriptions.text-to-video: Plan prompt(s) for video generation from text
enumDescriptions.image-to-video: Plan prompt(s) for animating a source image into a video
enumDescriptions.video-edit: Plan prompt(s) for editing an existing MP4 video with natural language

description.title: 2. Creative Brief
description.description: Core creative brief. Describe the subject, action, environment, emotional tone, and the specific cinematic outcome you want.
examples: A weary detective under red neon rain, cinematic neo-noir frame with reflective wet pavement
Transform this family portrait into a warm 1990s romantic drama still with subtle film grain
A sweeping sci-fi city reveal at dusk with massive scale and controlled camera motion
Edit this MP4 so the woman now wears a silver necklace and the lighting becomes warm golden hour

outputLanguage.title: 3. Prompt Language
outputLanguage.description: Language used in the generated prompt text.

enumDescriptions.th: Thai prompt with technical film terms kept in English when natural

style.title: 4. Visual Style
style.description: High-level visual style. This is a creative hint layer, not a direct xAI API parameter.

enumDescriptions.cinematic: Film-like quality, deliberate framing, dramatic lighting
enumDescriptions.anime: Japanese animation look, cel-shaded, expressive color
enumDescriptions.cartoon: Western animation look, bold outlines, exaggerated features
enumDescriptions.noir: High contrast, shadow-heavy, moody black-and-white or desaturated style
enumDescriptions.vintage: Retro filmic treatment, aged palette, historical feel

filmLookPreset.title: 5. Film Look Preset
filmLookPreset.description: Cinematic sub-preset used to build a stronger film grammar block in the prompt. Creative hint only.

enumDescriptions.blockbuster: Big scale, bold contrast, polished spectacle
enumDescriptions.indie_naturalistic: Soft realism, available light, restrained polish
enumDescriptions.neo_noir: Night mood, contrast, reflective surfaces, tension
enumDescriptions.period_drama: Elegant production design, historical texture, controlled light
enumDescriptions.sci_fi_epic: Large scale future worlds, graphic light, clean silhouettes
enumDescriptions.elevated_horror: Atmospheric dread, low-key light, unsettling composition
enumDescriptions.romantic_drama: Warm emotional softness, flattering light, intimate framing
enumDescriptions.coming_of_age: Youthful warmth, nostalgic realism, gentle kinetic energy
enumDescriptions.crime_thriller: Tension, grit, procedural realism, darker palette
enumDescriptions.fantasy_epic: Mythic scale, magical atmosphere, painterly grandeur
enumDescriptions.arthouse_minimal: Sparse composition, negative space, understated restraint

genreTone.title: 6. Genre Tone
genreTone.description: Narrative tone to steer mood, pacing, framing, and visual emphasis. Creative hint only.

enumDescriptions.sci_fi: Future tech, world scale, engineered visual logic

aspectRatio.title: 7. Aspect Ratio
aspectRatio.description: API-supported aspect ratio. xAI supports this for image generation and video generation. For single-image edits, the API may keep the original input ratio.

enumDescriptions.auto: Let the model choose the best ratio

imageResolution.title: 8. Image Resolution
imageResolution.description: API-supported image output resolution note for downstream image generation or multi-image editing.

duration.title: 9. Video Duration (seconds)
duration.description: API-supported video duration note for downstream text-to-video and image-to-video execution. xAI allows 1-15 seconds. Existing video editing keeps the source duration.

resolution.title: 10. Video Resolution
resolution.description: API-supported output resolution note for downstream text-to-video and image-to-video execution. Existing video editing keeps the source resolution up to 720p.

shotType.title: 11. Shot Type
shotType.description: Shot framing / subject distance. Creative prompt hint.

enumDescriptions.establishing: Set the environment and scene geography
enumDescriptions.extreme_close_up: Micro detail, eyes, texture, object detail

cameraMovement.title: 12. Camera Movement
cameraMovement.description: Virtual camera motion. Creative prompt hint for video modes.

enumDescriptions.dolly: Move in or out through space
enumDescriptions.rack_focus: Shift focus between planes or subjects

cameraRig.title: 13. Camera Rig
cameraRig.description: Physical shooting feel to emulate. Creative prompt hint.

cameraFormat.title: 14. Camera Format
cameraFormat.description: Capture medium to emulate. Creative prompt hint.

lensProfile.title: 15. Lens Profile
lensProfile.description: Lens behavior to emulate. Creative prompt hint.

enumDescriptions.anamorphic_24mm: Wide anamorphic with lens character and flare
enumDescriptions.macro: Extreme close texture and object detail
enumDescriptions.tilt_shift: Selective plane of focus, stylized perspective

depthOfField.title: 16. Depth of Field
depthOfField.description: Focus falloff treatment. Creative prompt hint.

colorPalette.title: 18. Color Palette
colorPalette.description: Overall palette direction. Creative prompt hint.

enumDescriptions.vintage_film: Aged highlights, faded blacks, film bias

colorGrade.title: 19. Color Grade
colorGrade.description: Post-style grade to emulate. Creative prompt hint.

enumDescriptions.auto: Infer from film preset and tone
enumDescriptions.silver_retention: Cool dense blacks with subtle color

enumDescriptions.crushed_blacks: Dense shadows with aggressive black floor

grainLevel.title: 21. Film Grain
grainLevel.description: Film texture strength. Creative prompt hint.

enumDescriptions.auto: Infer from camera format and preset

era.title: 22. Era / Time Signature
era.description: Time-period flavor to infuse into wardrobe, production design, color, and lens behavior. Creative prompt hint.

enumDescriptions.1920s: Art deco, early cinema, period elegance

compositionRule.title: 23. Composition Rule
compositionRule.description: Composition strategy to emphasize in the prompt. Creative prompt hint.

enumDescriptions.leading_lines: Use lines to guide the eye
enumDescriptions.negative_space: Intentional open space around the subject

characters.title: 25. Character Descriptions
characters.description: Character descriptions, one per line. Format: Name: visual description. Used as prompt guidance, not a native API field.
examples: Mia: Thai woman, late 20s, long black hair, white linen shirt, tired eyes, gentle smile
Detective: Male, 40s, stubble, dark trench coat, rain-soaked, weary expression

characterConsistency.title: 26. Character Consistency
characterConsistency.description: When true, the prompt should include a compact character reference block for appearance consistency across outputs.

reference_images.title: 27. Reference Images
reference_images.description: Reference sources for image-edit or image-to-video prompt planning. Accept up to 3 sources. Each item may be a public image URL or a base64 data URI such as data:image/png;base64,... These are intended for downstream gateway execution.

referenceNotes.title: 28. Reference Notes
referenceNotes.description: What to preserve, what to change, and which reference matters most when the downstream generation skill uses the references.
examples: Keep the face and pose from image 1, borrow wardrobe colors from image 2, change lighting to golden hour.
Preserve the city skyline layout but make the mood closer to a dystopian neo-noir thriller.

sourceVideoUrl.title: 29. Source Video URL
sourceVideoUrl.description: Required for video-edit mode. Use a public MP4 URL. The downstream generation skill should preserve the input duration/aspect ratio/resolution; xAI video editing caps output at 720p.

videoEditStrength.title: 30. Video Edit Strength
videoEditStrength.description: How aggressively the edit should transform the existing video. Creative hint for edit prompts.

enumDescriptions.balanced: Visible change while retaining core footage
enumDescriptions.aggressive: Strong transformation while still respecting the source

numberOfVariations.title: 31. Number of Variations
numberOfVariations.description: How many prompt variations to return. Matches xAI image batch behavior conceptually, but here it is only for prompt planning.

negativeElements.title: 32. Avoid / Guardrail Notes
negativeElements.description: App-level creative guardrails only. xAI docs do not currently document a native negative prompt parameter for Grok Imagine. Use this to tell the prompt writer what to minimize or avoid.
examples: avoid plastic-looking skin, avoid over-saturated highlights, avoid extra fingers
avoid generic stock-photo smile, avoid flat front lighting

pipeline.title: 33. Legacy Pipeline
pipeline.description: Deprecated compatibility field. This skill is prompt-only and always behaves as `prompt_only`. Actual generation is delegated to a separate media-generation skill that executes through the app gateway for billing and credit accounting.

enumDescriptions.prompt_only: Generate the optimized prompt package only

examples.description: A lone detective in the rain under red neon, reflective pavement, cinematic neo-noir still
Transform this portrait into a warm 1990s romantic drama frame
examples.referenceNotes: Preserve face, pose, and wardrobe silhouette; shift lighting and grade only.

examples.description: A giant spacecraft reveal over a futuristic city at dusk with strong scale and controlled motion
Animate this still so the model slowly turns toward camera and the curtain moves gently
examples.referenceNotes: Keep framing and facial identity stable. Motion should remain subtle.

examples.description: Give the woman a silver necklace and make the scene feel like warm golden hour drama
